description: This PHP source file defines the ProjectController class in the OrangeHRM Time module. It extends an abstract Vue controller and utilizes traits for permission and project service functionalities. The class includes a preRender method that prepares a Vue component with unselectable project IDs and sets permissions.

classes.name: ProjectController
classes.description: Controller handling project-related actions in the Time module, rendering a Vue component with project data.

methods.name: preRender
methods.description: Prepares the Vue component with unselectable project IDs and sets necessary permissions before rendering.
